economic_bridge.math_boundary: For fixed gross win W>0, gross loss L>0 and equal known all-in cost c, expected net=p*W-(1-p)*L-c, so break-even p=(L+c)/(W+L). For W=1,L=2,2/3 applies only at c=0. Real stop slippage/tail losses and uncertain p can violate the fixed-payoff assumptions.
economic_bridge.atomic_boundary: Reverting exchanged asset balances does not establish net profit after gas/bids/failed attempts, nor make two independent venue orders atomic.
economic_bridge.implementation_limit: R334 is one offline allocation batch: durable reservation/lifecycle bridging and authenticated calibration/fees/quotes remain unfinished; no repeated allocator or strategy activation authorized by these source records.
